name: Renewal notice found
description: The enterprise way into a renewal review on CLM + IAM (the owner 11-21): Agreement Manager's AI reads every executed CLM contract, and when its obligation extraction finishes CLM's smart rule 'Renewal notice found' (event Document Obligation Extraction, In Subfolder /Contracts; assets/clm-smart-rules/specs/fontara-iamclm-renewals.json) starts this workflow on the document. Use Obligation Data reads the document's Agreement Manager obligations as XML; if one is a Renewal Notice, Renewal Status becomes Review due and 'Renewal review' starts on the same document (the owner's choice: Renew, Renegotiate or Let expire). Contracts whose renewal the AI does not find keep the date reminders (rule 'Schedule renewal reminders').

steps.name: Hand the document to the review
Log review started
steps.message: Renewal Notice found by Agreement Manager's AI: renewal review started

steps.name: Log no renewal notice
steps.message: No Renewal Notice among the Agreement Manager obligations: the date reminders cover this contract
